title: Covariance and density expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $h:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$. The covariance of the function on $\{\pm1\}^n$ induced by $\varphi$ through the coordinatewise binary-to-sign bijection with the real-valued version of $h$ equals the expectation of $h$ under $\varphi$ (evaluated after that bijection) minus the uniform mean of $h$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$
